description: This file defines a helper class for interacting with Facebook's Graph API, including authentication, fetching user data, news feeds, and processing different post types for display.

classes.name: facebook_helper
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating Facebook API interactions, including authentication, fetching user info, and processing feed stories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Facebook SDK with app credentials from configuration.

methods.name: get_my_user
methods.description: Returns the current logged-in user's data via Facebook API.

methods.name: get_my_newsfeed
methods.description: Retrieves the user's Facebook news feed.

methods.name: get_other_newsfeed
methods.description: Retrieves the feed of a specified user with an optional limit.

methods.name: get_login_url
methods.description: Generates a login URL with specified permissions.

methods.name: get_facebook_user
methods.description: Gets Facebook user information by username.

methods.name: process_feed
methods.description: Processes a Facebook feed story based on its type.

methods.name: photo_status
methods.description: Generates HTML for a photo story post.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Generates HTML for a status story post.

methods.name: link_type
methods.description: Generates HTML for a link story post.

methods.name: video_type
methods.description: Generates HTML for a video story post.

methods.name: get_to
methods.description: Extracts the 'to' user name from a story.
